To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We proposed a model based reinforcement learning method, guided policy search ( GPS), to learn driving policies in urban autonomous driving tasks.

we developed a model-based reinforcement learning algorithm of guided policy for autonomous driving in the urban environment, which has the advantages of sample efficiency, better stability, and greater interpretability, and is capable of solving more challenging driving tasks.
We propose a model-based reinforcement learning method to learn robust urban autonomous driving policies, and validate its effectiveness in the Carla simulator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of model based reinforcement learning methods for learning driving policies in autonomous driving.
developing a learning based approach to learn driving policies that enable an autonomous driving agent to navigate in an urban environment.
the development of autonomous vehicles for urban driving scenarios and the application of model based RL to solve such tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model based RL methods have great potentials in learning robust and efficient driving policies for autonomous urban driving.

the proposed method can learn driving policies in urban driving tasks with higher sample efficiency, greater stability and better interpretability, which is more suitable for the real world applications.
the proposed GPS based method can be a very promising candidate for autonomous driving in complex and interactive urban environments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully applied model based RL to urban autonomous driving, and have achieved better sample efficiency and stability than the model free RL methods.

the proposed model based reinforcement learning method is capable to learn robust driving policies for autonomous urban driving in Carla simulator, and is more sample efficient than model free reinforcement learning methods.

the proposed method can be used to learn driving policies with higher sample efficiency, which can be used to train autonomous driving policies for urban driving scenarios in a simulator, and then transfer to real autonomous driving vehicles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
model based RL methods can be used to solve complex and interactive tasks like urban driving, which has great potential for autonomous driving.
, the proposed model based RL approach can be a promising candidate to learn robust driving policies for urban autonomous driving.
, model based RL methods, especially the GPS method, are very effective for autonomous driving in complex urban environments.
